fields.label: Cluster
fields.help: The source cluster from which Backups will be created via this BackupPlan.

fields.label: Deactivated
fields.help: This flag indicates whether this BackupPlan has been deactivated.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: User specified descriptive string for this BackupPlan.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The region of the Backup Plan.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The full name of the BackupPlan Resource.

fields.label: Backup Config
All Namespaces
fields.help: If True, include all namespaced resources.

fields.label: Include Secrets
fields.help: This flag specifies whether Kubernetes Secret resources should be included when they fall into the scope of Backups.

fields.label: Include Volume Data
fields.help: This flag specifies whether volume data should be backed up when PVCs are included in the scope of a Backup.

fields.label: Permissive Mode
fields.help: This flag specifies whether Backups will not fail when Backup for GKE detects Kubernetes configuration that is non-standard or requires additional setup to restore.

fields.label: Encryption Key
Gcp KMS Encryption Key
fields.help: Google Cloud KMS encryption key.
This defines a customer managed encryption key that will be used to encrypt the "config" portion (the Kubernetes resources) of Backups created via this plan.

fields.label: Selected Applications
Namespaced Names
Name
fields.help: The name of a Kubernetes Resource.

fields.label: Namespace
fields.help: The namespace of a Kubernetes Resource.
A list of namespaced Kubernetes resources.
A list of namespaced Kubernetes Resources.

fields.label: Selected Namespace Labels
Resource Labels
Key
fields.help: The key of the kubernetes label.

fields.label: Value
fields.help: The value of the Label.
A list of Kubernetes Namespace labels.
If set, include just the resources in the listed namespace Labels.

fields.label: Selected Namespaces
Namespaces
fields.help: A list of Kubernetes Namespaces.
If set, include just the resources in the listed namespaces.
Defines the configuration of Backups created via this BackupPlan.

fields.label: Backup Schedule
Cron Schedule
fields.help: A standard cron string that defines a repeating schedule for creating Backups via this BackupPlan.

fields.label: Paused
fields.help: This flag denotes whether automatic Backup creation is paused for this BackupPlan.

fields.label: Rpo Config
Target Rpo Minutes
fields.help: Defines the target RPO for the BackupPlan in minutes, which means the target maximum data loss in time that is acceptable for this BackupPlan.

fields.label: Exclusion Windows
Daily
fields.help: The exclusion window occurs every day if set to "True".

fields.label: Duration
fields.help: Specifies duration of the window in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, terminated by 's'.

fields.label: Days Of Week
Days Of Week
fields.help: A list of days of week.
The exclusion window occurs on these days of each week in UTC.

fields.label: Single Occurrence Date
Day
fields.help: Day of a month.

fields.label: Month
fields.help: Month of a year.

fields.label: Year
fields.help: Year of the date.
No recurrence.

fields.label: Start Time
Hours
fields.help: Hours of day in 24 hour format.

fields.label: Minutes
fields.help: Minutes of hour of day.

fields.label: Nanos
fields.help: Fractions of seconds in nanoseconds.

fields.label: Seconds
fields.help: Seconds of minutes of the time.
Specifies the start time of the window using time of the day in UTC.
User specified time windows during which backup can NOT happen for this BackupPlan.
Defines the RPO schedule configuration for this BackupPlan.
Defines a schedule for automatic Backup creation via this BackupPlan.

fields.label: Retention Policy
Backup Delete Lock Days
fields.help: Minimum age for a Backup created via this BackupPlan (in days).

fields.label: Backup Retain Days
fields.help: The default maximum age of a Backup created via this BackupPlan.

fields.label: Locked
fields.help: This flag denotes whether the retention policy of this BackupPlan is locked.
RetentionPolicy governs lifecycle of Backups created under this plan.
